description: Use this when the user wants pools across chains or DEXes with recent volume and a fee rate, such as "high fee pools on Base with real volume". Optionally pass chains, a minimum 1-day volume, a minimum fee percent, and a limit up to 8. Returns each pool's volume, TVL, fee rate, 1-day and 7-day fee APR, and an APR flag, highest fee APR first. It does not read token contracts or the current tick. Call check_pool with a returned pool id for token flags. Not financial advice.

chains.description: Optional chain names. Omit to scan every chain in the index

limit.description: How many pools to return, at most 8. Default 5

min_fee_percent.description: Minimum swap fee in percent, from pool metadata. Default 0.05

name: find_active_pools
title: Find pools with volume and fees
